note: Gameplay approximations of the Islamic Emirate on 1 January 2000. Economy and trade: no functioning central economic management; transit trade was largely unregulated (laissez_faire, free_trade). Conscription: fighters were raised through the movement and local commanders (volunteer_force). Press: no independent media (total_censorship). Political freedom: no elections or parties (no_elections). Civil rights: enforced by religious police (police_state). Religion: the movement's interpretation of sharia was the law (theocratic_law). Education: largely religious schooling, with girls excluded (ideological_education). Internet: very little access existed; filtered_internet is an approximation.
